description:
## Context

`OctoPi.TUI.Interactive` (`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`) has a dead clause in `handle_ui_request/2` at lines 282–284:

```elixir
def handle_ui_request(state, {:custom, _factory, _opts}) do
  {state, :pending}
end
```

This clause is unreachable. `handle_call/3` at lines 531–539 has a dedicated clause for `{:ui_request, {:custom, factory, _kw}}` that always intercepts `:custom` requests before `handle_ui_request` is ever invoked:

```elixir
def handle_call({:ui_request, {:custom, factory, _kw}}, from, state) do
  interactive_pid = self()
  tui = %{request_render: fn -> send(interactive_pid, :force_render) end}
  theme = build_custom_theme(state)
  done = fn result -> send(interactive_pid, {:custom_done, from, result}) end
  component = factory.(tui, theme, done)
  new_state = render_frame(%{state | custom_widget: {from, component}})
  {:noreply, new_state, loader_timeout(new_state)}
end
```

The dead clause gives a false impression that there is an alternate `:custom` handling path available to future non-Interactive `UIHost` implementations (e.g., a future RPC UIHost). If that were actually intended it would be in the `@callback` contract in `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/ui_host.ex`, not silently present only in Interactive.

## Change

Delete lines 282–284 in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`:

```elixir
# DELETE this entire clause:
def handle_ui_request(state, {:custom, _factory, _opts}) do
  {state, :pending}
end
```

No other files need to change.

## Verification

- Run `mix test apps/octo_pi_tui/`.
- Confirm `{:ui_request, {:custom, ...}}` still works end-to-end by tracing through the `handle_call` clause at L531.
title: Remove unreachable `:custom` clause from `handle_ui_request`
